portfolioProposal.name: One-joint pendulum calibration and sensor robustness report
portfolioProposal.scope: Build one fixed-base hinge-link MJCF model with primitive geometry in MuJoCo; produce a repeatable Python experiment and short engineering report. This is an authored proposal, not an employer requirement.
steps: Declare units, measured/assumed mass, length, inertia, joint axis, initial angle, timestep and damping.
Load MJCF with MjModel.from_xml_path, create MjData, step with mj_step and log copied qpos/time.
Compare undamped small-angle period with the analytical expectation; sweep timestep to reveal numerical sensitivity.

Add hinge damping, fit only that bounded parameter to one free-decay trace; hold a second initial-angle trace aside. Use video-tracked physical pendulum angles if available, or explicitly labeled synthetic data if not.
Inject seeded observation noise and sampled latency in a Python observation wrapper; keep clean simulator state distinct from corrupted observations.
Report held-out angle RMSE, oscillation-period error, decay mismatch and runtime; store seeds/configuration and a regression check.
deliverables: raw angle traces, provenance/units and fit/holdout split
parameter sweep and held-out error plots
short report identifying model assumptions and failures
portfolioProposal.credibleClaim: Demonstrates model construction, numerical checks, bounded fitting, reproducibility and observation-model testing. With real measurement it demonstrates a limited model-to-measurement comparison; synthetic recovery alone does not demonstrate sim-to-real transfer.
portfolioProposal.notExecuted: APIs and parameter semantics checked in primary docs; portfolio experiment itself was not built or benchmarked during this evidence audit.
